buyer_question: Which brief and output dictionary versions govern this comparison?
completion_guidance: Reference approved documents; do not recreate targeting criteria here.

buyer_question: Which working arrangement and intended decision does this copy cover?
completion_guidance: Use one copy per in-house, licensed-tool, commissioned or explicitly described hybrid arrangement.

buyer_question: Which company-level outputs are included and explicitly excluded?
completion_guidance: Reference required files and views; personal contacts and outreach are outside this checklist.

buyer_question: Who may approve the delivery and who may resolve a disputed decision?
completion_guidance: Use internal role labels; separate production from review where agreed.

buyer_question: Which items are blocking and what inspection method will be used?
completion_guidance: Buyer chooses full review or a defined sample; state its scope and limitations without a default pass rate.

buyer_question: How are accepted companies distinguished from supplied rows and unresolved work?
completion_guidance: Specify included, hold, duplicate and rejected views; cross-reference the batch audit rather than inventing a count.

buyer_question: Which missing or conflicting required fields prevent acceptance?
completion_guidance: Reference the field dictionary, allowed unknown values and agreed stopping rules.

buyer_question: What test deliverable must pass before the format is agreed?
completion_guidance: Use a fictional or separately authorised non-sensitive example; do not upload real prospects for this exercise.

buyer_question: Which file format, encoding, field names and data types are required?
completion_guidance: Specify identifiers as text, date conventions and explicit unknown values; do not infer defaults.

buyer_question: Can the intended import preserve identifiers and company-to-site relationships?
completion_guidance: Document a local test using non-sensitive data, including leading zeros and multi-site records.

buyer_question: Which evidence references, dates and decision fields survive export?
completion_guidance: Compare the agreed field map with the received file; do not rely only on a screen view.

buyer_question: How will the approved version and received file be reconciled?
completion_guidance: Agree version labels and row-identifier checks; choose a checksum or other integrity check if appropriate.

buyer_question: Which access or administrator settings govern the required export?
completion_guidance: Confirm for the actual arrangement; an available control is not a licence for a use.

buyer_question: What permitted evidence format will accompany each material field?
completion_guidance: Separate links, original notes and authorised extracts; keep source content out where rights are unresolved.

buyer_question: How can a reviewer challenge a finding if a link or source access fails?
completion_guidance: Agree a permitted verification route and the consequence if evidence cannot be inspected.

buyer_question: How are disputed records reported, investigated and resolved?
completion_guidance: Agree a case reference, role owner, changed-field history and closure evidence.

buyer_question: What review window and correction or replacement terms are actually agreed?
completion_guidance: Leave all values blank until agreed; this worksheet supplies no deadline, entitlement or allowance.

buyer_question: How is a defect distinguished from new scope or later changed circumstances?
completion_guidance: Compare with the approved brief and the documented state at handover; record disagreements.

buyer_question: Which roles own acceptance, import, rights review and unresolved questions?
completion_guidance: Use roles rather than named people; responsibility does not establish intellectual-property ownership.

buyer_question: Who maintains the output after handover and what triggers review?
completion_guidance: Specify a buyer-chosen trigger and handover record; do not assume a refresh service is included.

buyer_question: Who propagates corrections into downstream internal copies?
completion_guidance: Name responsible roles and affected systems without listing personal data or credentials.

buyer_question: Who owns buyer-supplied inputs, original analysis and the compiled deliverable?
completion_guidance: Record these separately and cite the applicable agreement; do not assume payment transfers ownership.

buyer_question: Which third-party components remain subject to separate restrictions?
completion_guidance: List component categories and controlling references without reproducing restricted material.

buyer_question: Which recipients and internal CRM uses are authorised?
completion_guidance: Distinguish individual access, team access and onward use; obtain written confirmation for the intended arrangement.

buyer_question: Are customer-facing summaries, extracts or onward sharing permitted?
completion_guidance: Record each intended use separately; no permission is supplied by this checklist, a link or rewritten wording.

buyer_question: What are the agreed uses of buyer inputs by the provider or tool?
completion_guidance: Check processing, retention and any secondary use separately; provide no private files during this exercise.

buyer_question: What may be retained or used after completion or access expiry?
completion_guidance: Distinguish continued access, retained outputs, source material and derived notes; no universal deletion or retention rule is assumed.

buyer_question: What must be removed or returned, by whom and from which copies?
completion_guidance: Record applicable triggers and obligations; agree how compliance will be documented without assuming rights.

buyer_question: Which agreement version, exceptions and review role support the rights decision?
completion_guidance: Reference the applicable order or licence and approved exceptions; source visibility is not clearance.

buyer_question: Are all buyer-designated blocking items resolved for the intended use?
completion_guidance: An unanswered item is not a pass; distinguish unresolved, blocked, confirmed and justified not-applicable statuses.

buyer_question: Which non-blocking exceptions remain and who accepts them?
completion_guidance: Record authorised role, rationale and review trigger; an exception cannot grant unavailable rights.

buyer_question: What final decision and approved version will be recorded?
completion_guidance: Record proceed, hold or decline only after the required review; completing this file is not automatic acceptance.
